part.text:
Fixed in `lib/adapters/http.js:331`: when `maxBodyLength` is unlimited (`-1` or any negative value), the adapter now passes `Infinity` to `follow-redirects`, overriding its implicit 10MB default. This makes behavior consistent with `maxRedirects: 0` and preserves explicit limits.

Verified the targeted `maxBodyLength`/`maxContentLength` tests pass (4 passing), including the previously failing 20MB default-body test.
